description: Finance teams spend hours manually entering receipts into spreadsheets. There is no automated way to capture receipt data from mobile photos or email attachments.
Companies with international employees struggle to reconcile expenses across different currencies. Current tools require manual conversion and create accounting errors.
Department managers have no real-time view of team spending against budgets. They only discover overruns at month-end reporting.
AP teams manually match vendor invoices to purchase orders. The process is error-prone and creates payment delays.
Employees frequently submit out-of-policy expenses. There is no automated way to flag or block non-compliant submissions before approval.
Companies lack visibility into software subscription spend across departments. Duplicate subscriptions and unused licenses are costing thousands monthly.
Accountants must manually categorize each transaction for tax purposes. This is error-prone and creates risk during audits.
Approval workflows are slow because approvers are not notified promptly. Employees wait days for reimbursement creating friction.
Reconciling corporate card transactions with expense reports is a manual monthly process that takes 2-3 days.
Project managers cannot easily allocate expenses to specific projects or client billing codes. Cost tracking is inaccurate.
